name: Korabl'-Sputnik-5
about: Korabl'-Sputnik-5 (1961 IOT 1), a crewed vehicle (Vostok3A), launched 1961 Mar 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1961 Mar 25), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KRZ?) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
